title: List of Questions to Increase Your Productivity

list: Identify your current main objectives in life / high-level goals.
What are your top ten productivity killers?
Identify the top three killers you have the most influence over.
Brainstorm how to solve the top three killers.
Identify the top action you can take in the next day to improve your productivity.
What is the top thing you "should be doing" but keep putting off?
Commit to having a better day tomorrow, and work on the top three items for the next week.
Clarify when you want to be productive and when you want to be down (just a general outline).
